title: Enhance assets without losing approved sources
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for enhance assets without losing approved sources.

ordered_stages.action: Hash and copy source assets into a read-only comparison set.
Choose the smallest reversible enhancement for each measured defect.
Produce new candidates without overwriting originals.
Generate before/after technical, visual, temporal, and runtime evidence.
Replace production references only after explicit human approval.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Enhancement does not introduce identity drift, temporal artifacts, or budget regressions.

fallbacks: Reject the candidate and retain the source asset.
Apply a deterministic editor correction instead of a generative enhancement.
